_note: Player skills (docs/design/equipment_skills_robots.md section 2; the curve is docs/design/quests_levels_story.md section 2). scope player: each player has their own; farm: one shared by the whole farm [ASSUMPTION]. level_curve: going from level n to n + 1 costs base_xp × growth^(n − 1), so total XP to reach level n = round(base_xp × (growth^(n − 1) − 1) / (growth − 1)). effect_share: how much of an effect's full cut a level has, in straight lines between the rows. calibration_tier_xp: XP from a calibration is multiplied by the entry for the tier of the standard used (Tier 0 first). effects: full is the cut at the top level, as a fraction of the base; what is left is never under floor. unlocks: the level that shows more. old_curve is only for converting a save from the 10-level curve (total = base_xp × (n − 1) × n / 2): its XP is multiplied by xp_factor, and old_per_level under each effect is what one old level cut. Every number is a [PLACEHOLDER]; the xp_sources are today's ×5, right for levels 1 to 25 only and not yet tuned to the hour budget. calibrate_robot and calibrate_robot_player replace calibrate_player for a robot's sensor. A source with per gives its xp for each of those, rounded to a whole XP: job_done for every finished paid job and job_clean too when it was on time and traceable, both by the credits paid after any cut; harvest_in_spec for a crop harvested in spec and sell_crop for a sale to Lin, both by what Lin pays for the crops before fronted seed is taken out [PLACEHOLDER]. crop: the source is crop work. Its XP goes to Field Ops until Agronomy exists, and each player's total from these is kept (GameState.action_counts) so it can move then. lab_xp_sources feed the lab level, not a skill (docs/design/quests_levels_story.md section 3.2): one XP total for the whole farm on the same curve, earned by anyone's work in the lab; every value is a [PLACEHOLDER]. lab_calibration is a traceable calibration by a player and lab_robot_calibration one by a robot, both times calibration_tier_xp and only when the instrument was not calibrated too soon; buy_standard and calibrate_standard (a standard calibrated on the bench by a player, on top of lab_calibration) are times calibration_tier_xp too, and were the Instrumentation skill's sources; lab_job is for every finished paid job, by the credits paid; lab_clean_audit a clean audit; lab_certificate a standard back from OIRM with its certificate; lab_spool a spool collected or slotted; lab_robot a robot built, and again when it is commissioned; lab_area a lab area fitted and lab_grown the lab made bigger. lab_level/size_xp: every lab XP source is multiplied by the entry for the lab's size (the ids of economy.json lab/sizes) [PLACEHOLDER].
